chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample J, 1/5
chunks.content: Sample J scored 1/5 (Report on Existing Knowledge). Topic: the impact of eczema ('the purpose of the research is to find a...'). The paper has a researchable topic but reports existing knowledge; it does not earn a 2 because there is no evidence the named 'qualitative' method was actually used, and it does not build a new understanding. Illustrates the 1 band and the 1-vs-2 boundary — a method named but not demonstrably applied stays at 1.
